## First grade · `domain:ui` · p2 · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T09:55Z

Read in this act: the body in full, 0 comments.

- **Lane: `domain:ui`** (`packages/fields`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-view`, `app-shell`).
- **Grade: p2.** It closes out objectstack-ai/objectui#12622's family. Action-param and bulk dialogs, inline editors and list filters still take their date placeholder and digit order from the machine's locale, not the console's.
- **Scope, as the body asks:**
  - **Item 1 (dialogs) is this card's build:** recommendation A, `fieldWidgetMap`'s `date` / `datetime` move to the picker and `FORM_FACE_LOADERS` is dropped, so each field type has one face.
  - **Item 2 (inline editors and filters) is measured first in the same claim.** A popover inside a grid cell or a filter row is a different interaction. The measurement decides whether it rides this PR or becomes its own card.
  - **Item 3** (retire the unused exported `DatePicker`) narrows a published `@object-ui/components` export, so it is the maintainer's call. It is noted in this seat's round report, ⛔ not built here.
- **State: `pm:queue`.**
- **Labels:** `finding` → `bug`.

⛔ Not a claim.

- `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`: `fieldWidgetMap`'s `date` / `datetime` entries, `FORM_FACE_LOADERS` and `registerField`'s use of it, and their docblocks only;
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/date-picker/**`, only if a dialog needs a fix there;
- the three pins the body names: `packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.test.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ActionDesigner.paramVocabulary.test.tsx`, `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkActionDialogParams.test.tsx`; new tests beside;
- item 2, only if it rides: `packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx`, `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx`, and the filter rows (`FilterBuilder`, `UserFilters`, `plugin-view` `FilterUI`), with tests beside;
- one `.changeset/12642-*.md`.

Outside the surface: `@object-ui/components`' unused `DatePicker` export (item 3, the maintainer's call); any new type, prop, export or pack key; the value a date or datetime writes (`YYYY-MM-DD`, an ISO instant). A route that needs any of these stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the 8 planned paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: `FORM_FACE_LOADERS` is module-private, and `fieldWidgetMap`'s keys, which `RegisteredFieldWidgetType` and `FORM_FIELD_TYPES` derive from, do not change. `getLazyFieldWidget('date' | 'datetime')` returns another component with the same props and the same written value. Every widening route is a stop-and-report by this claim.
Responsibility: (1) objectui's own code: `fieldWidgetMap` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx:4311`) maps `date` / `datetime` to the native-input widgets for every non-form consumer, and PR #12641 overrode only the registry's form face (`FORM_FACE_LOADERS`, `:4735`). (2) No platform path covers it: the field type carries no display format, and the console's display locale reaches only the record form's picker. (3) Anyone who fills a `date` / `datetime` action param or bulk-action field reaches it through `ActionParamDialog.tsx:579` or the grid's bulk dialog. Whether a shipped app declares one today is unmeasured; the dev measures one live declaration and reports it.
Thread-read: 6212942609
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `8a8bcf3dde`.
- PR #12641 (objectui#12622, seat 2), which the card follows, merged.
- PR #12646 (objectui#12613, seat 3, draft) edits `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` in the cell-renderer regions only (its hunks start at lines 15, 367, 376, 685, 3268 and 3987), not `fieldWidgetMap` or `FORM_FACE_LOADERS`. Ordinary concurrency: the later lander merges `main`.
- PR #12643 (objectui#12619) edits `plugin-kanban` and `plugin-list`, not `FieldEditWidget`. This seat's in-flight objectui#12639 and #12602 are disjoint.
